Barcelona v Aston Villa (Kick-off 8.00pm). Coverage of the league phase match from Spotify Camp Nou. This is the first meeting between these two sides since 1983 when they met in a two-legged tie in the UEFA Super Cup. Both sides won their opening two matches in this year's competition, with both teams scoring nine goals in those fixtures. Barcelona did however suffer their first defeat of the campaign as they lost 4-2 to Paris Saint-Germain in a thrilling game in Paris last time out.
